newsitem.title: UK: LPC - Spie Trindel seeks FF400 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Spie Trindel seeks FF400 mln loan.

text.p: LONDON, January 30 (LPC)- French electrical company Spie Trindel has mandated Societe Generale to arrange a 400 million franc term loan, according to a source close to the deal.

The five-year credit is sought by holding company Financiere Spie Trindel to back its purchase of the 50 per cent stake in Spie Trindel held by engineering group Schneider. The other 50 per cent is owned by parent company Spie Batignolles.

Spie Trindel will acquire the stake in two stages, 31 per cent will be bought immediately for 400 million francs and the remaining 19 per cent will be acquired in three to four years for 250 million francs, sources said.
Spie Batignolles, the parent company of the Spie group, plans also to acquire the 1 billion franc stake of its share capital, which is owned by Schneider, through a management buyout.
